testCase.name: [dev] S16 Trash icon opens an app-style pop-up that explains the delete; Cancel keeps the patient

descriptionHtml:
Bug B24 · P1 · known

Delete: Hospital uses the browser's native confirm and shows no 'deleted' toast; Nursing Home residents cannot be deleted at all

Tickets: TFA-92579 AC7 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S17, OAT-06/S22

Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S16 Trash icon opens an app-style pop-up that explains the delete; Cancel keeps the patient

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T5 A patient card can be removed by tapping its trash icon; a pop-up designed like the app UI tells the user what happens if they delete, and the user presses Cancel or OK. (TFA-92579 AC 7)
  • T3 Delete asks for confirmation once; there is no bulk delete in V1. (TFA-92579 AC 2; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Standard fixture

When Nursing Home first: tap the trash icon on the resident's card, read the pop-up, press Cancel; then the same on the Hospital card

Then An in-app pop-up (not the browser's native confirm) names the patient, says what deleting does, offers Cancel and OK; after Cancel the card is still there

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: pop-up snapshot mustContain 'button "Cancel"' and 'button "OK"' and mustNotContain 'native dialog:' (the marker the agent writes when a browser dialog opens); pop-up text file (only the pop-up's own text, so the card behind it cannot satisfy the check) mustContain the name and 'delete'; after-cancel checkpoint mustContain 'Open chart for <name>'. …

Where it ran: dev unit U09; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92579 ready for qa

Deleting a Hospital patient opens the browser's own confirm box instead of an app-style pop-up with Cancel/OK, and Nursing Home cards have no trash icon at all; Cancel does keep the patient.

Evidence: dev U09 (ledger #9). Already in dev report §2 #7 (TFA-92579 AC 7). Q6 (whether Nursing Home residents should be deletable from the card) is still open. Q8: ACs 2/4/7/8 were added on 10-01 and no PR covers them.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S16

Trash icon opens an app-style pop-up that explains the delete; Cancel keeps the patient

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

Result: Fail from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (generated/tc01s16/verdict.json). Agent: 22 turns, 71 s, $0.13. Native dialogs: 1.

Plan: unit U09 (#9, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Patient delete pop-up, Cancel. Legacy seed; permissions delete + dialog stay in a case of their own.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #9, U09; checked: yes): Fail (product) — TFA-92579 AC 7: Hospital delete uses the browser's native confirm, not an app-style pop-up with Cancel/OK; NH cards have no trash icon at all. Cancel keeps the patient (pass). ACs 2/4/7/8 were added 10-01, no PR yet. Same as the local smoke on 10-14.
